raw_provider_output.summary: A public service advertisement by Eskom urging consumers to conserve energy, using the visual metaphor of a billboard that is only partially illuminated to represent the consequences of power shortages.

observations.description: A large billboard structure is shown against a dark, twilight sky. The left two-thirds of the billboard are completely black and unlit, while the right third is brightly illuminated.
The text 'Use Electricity Wisely' is displayed in white sans-serif font on the illuminated section of the billboard.
The Eskom logo and brand name appear below the slogan on the lit portion of the billboard.
The billboard is supported by a tall, dark metal lattice tower structure.
The background is a dark, gradient sky, suggesting dusk or early night, with faint silhouettes of buildings or structures at the very bottom.

claims.text: The advertisement's primary message is a direct call to action for consumers to reduce their electricity consumption to prevent power outages.

The visual composition acts as a visual metaphor where the unlit portion of the billboard represents the 'darkness' or load-shedding that results from excessive electricity usage, while the lit portion represents the functioning grid.
The ad utilizes a stark contrast between light and dark to create a sense of urgency and demonstrate the immediate consequence of not following the advice.
The message targets the general public in regions where Eskom is the primary electricity provider, specifically those who may be experiencing or anticipating power cuts.
